name: The Business Playbook Series
author: Timothy Madu
tagline: Practical Thinking. Better Decisions. Stronger Businesses.
heroDescription: Practical playbooks for understanding your customers, evaluating revenue opportunities and deciding what to improve next.
authorBio: Timothy Madu is a business owner, entrepreneur and author based in Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, Nigeria. He owns KC TIMO AUTOMOBILES. His Business Playbook Series focuses on practical questions about customer experience, revenue opportunities and business improvement.
mission: To make practical business thinking accessible to owners and teams, with clear questions, structured methods and attention to what the evidence supports.
philosophy: Start with the real business problem.
Consider the costs and consequences of acting.
State only what the evidence supports.
seoDescription: Explore Timothy Madu’s Business Playbook Series: practical books on customer experience, revenue opportunities and business improvement.
